name: balanced999-incidents-speed30-comparison
question: How do the baseline and Zoo's exact speed30 bundle behave on the same999 balanced saved incidents?
owner_authorization: Owner requests a Zoo plan for the completed bank and a repeat with specimen4.2.6-reborn-rust-speed-fight and profile reborn-bundle-plan-speed30.
prespecified:
Pair both setups on the same999 saves (111 per class), with the same2000-engine-turn
and5-second native wall bounds, saved engine RNG and fresh Borg memory.
Speed30 means the complete original Zoo profile, including errands_plan.txt,
healing, shopping/trip settings, class attack preferences and danger_tenths=30.
Source193d9076 and borg-rs core differ from baseline6d1bca10 and reborn core;
do not attribute all differences to speed30 alone. Snapshot exact input files.
Stages18/90/360/900/999 are cumulative, with no replay of earlier cells.
At each gate verify native loaded state, parameters, core and loaded plan hash.
Preserve all1998 expected cells including missing/invalid/stopped outcomes.
Report paired rescued/newly-killed, both died, both survived, stopped and invalid,
by class and historical incident type, with source-life correlation explicit.
No games are dispatched by planning. Candidate configured execution and receipt
integration must pass the mixed-class smoke before the larger stages run.

Adds, over f02cd294 (4.2.6-reborn-rust-heal): #469 attack_speed_fight_danger_tenths (default 0 = off), #452 Potions of Speed hoarded, #464 a game's start leaves out borg.txt and flags.
